compute_cuboid_vertices_and_faces: compute the 3D vertices and face indices of a cuboid given its center, dimensions, and optional rotation matrix
project_3d_box_to_2d: project a 3D bounding box into 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsics and clip out-of-bounds vertices
compute_iou_between_boxes: compute the intersection over union between two sets of 2D bounding boxes in cross or list mode
convert_rotation_matrix_to_euler: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix into Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) using the standard decomposition
convert_rotation_to_allocentric: convert a camera rotation matrix to allocentric representation given a 2D pixel location and camera intrinsics
